newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North appoints new IOCC chairman.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North appoints new IOCC chairman.

text.p: Australian mining and forestry group North Ltd said on Friday it had appointed its executive director of operations, Malcolm Broomhead, as chairman of newly acquired subsidiary Iron Ore Company of Canada (IOCC).
North made the announcement after revealing it had bought a 59.3 percent interest in IOCC for US$230 million.

"Malcolm Broomhead is appointed to the new position of deputy managing director of North Ltd and will be appointed chairman of IOCC once North's acquisition of a majority interest in that company has been completed," North said. North expects the acquisition to be finalised on or before March 31.
Broomhead replaces current IOCC chairman Carl Meizner, who is allied with Bethlehem Steel Corp, North said.
